question_variants_original_ck.name: question_variants_original_ck
question_variants_original_ck.value: ("question_variants"."kind" = 'ORIGINAL' and "question_variants"."original_variant_id" is null) or ("question_variants"."kind" = 'VARIANT' and "question_variants"."original_variant_id" is not null)

question_versions_review_ck.name: question_versions_review_ck
question_versions_review_ck.value: "question_versions"."content_status" <> 'READY' or ("question_versions"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "question_versions"."reviewed_at" is not null) or "question_versions"."validation_decision_id" is not null

assessment_attempts_trial_ck.name: assessment_attempts_trial_ck
assessment_attempts_trial_ck.value: ("assessment_attempts"."purpose" = 'REGULAR' and "assessment_attempts"."phase_id" is null and "assessment_attempts"."trial_assignment_id" is null) or ("assessment_attempts"."purpose" <> 'REGULAR' and "assessment_attempts"."assessment_type" = 'DRILL' and "assessment_attempts"."phase_id" is not null and "assessment_attempts"."trial_assignment_id" is not null and "assessment_attempts"."raw_points" is null and "assessment_attempts"."score_0_100" is null and "assessment_attempts"."stars" is null and "assessment_attempts"."unlocked_level_id" is null)

assessment_attempts_stars_ck.name: assessment_attempts_stars_ck
assessment_attempts_stars_ck.value: "assessment_attempts"."stars" is null or ("assessment_attempts"."assessment_type" = 'DRILL' and "assessment_attempts"."stars" between 1 and 3)

assessment_packages_release_ck.name: assessment_packages_release_ck
assessment_packages_release_ck.value: "assessment_packages"."close_at" is null or "assessment_packages"."release_at" is null or "assessment_packages"."close_at" > "assessment_packages"."release_at"

assessment_packages_scope_ck.name: assessment_packages_scope_ck
assessment_packages_scope_ck.value: ("assessment_packages"."assessment_type" <> 'PRETEST' or "assessment_packages"."chapter_id" is not null) and ("assessment_packages"."assessment_type" <> 'DRILL' or "assessment_packages"."level_id" is not null)

level_progress_completed_ck.name: level_progress_completed_ck
level_progress_completed_ck.value: "level_progress"."completed_at" is null or ("level_progress"."unlocked_at" is not null and "level_progress"."completed_at" >= "level_progress"."unlocked_at")

pvp_players_reconnect_ck.name: pvp_players_reconnect_ck
pvp_players_reconnect_ck.value: "pvp_players"."reconnect_deadline_at" is null or ("pvp_players"."disconnected_at" is not null and "pvp_players"."reconnect_deadline_at" >= "pvp_players"."disconnected_at")

generation_candidates_payload_ck.name: generation_candidates_payload_ck
generation_candidates_payload_ck.value: "irt_compute"."generation_candidates"."candidate_question_version_id" is not null or ("irt_compute"."generation_candidates"."payload" is not null and "irt_compute"."generation_candidates"."payload_digest" is not null and "irt_compute"."generation_candidates"."random_seed" is not null and "irt_compute"."generation_candidates"."parameter_values" is not null and "irt_compute"."generation_candidates"."parent_original_question_version_id" is not null)

irt_item_results_insufficient_ck.name: irt_item_results_insufficient_ck
irt_item_results_insufficient_ck.value: "irt_item_results"."model_family" <> 'LEGACY' or "irt_item_results"."sample_size" >= 30 or ("irt_item_results"."difficulty_b" is null and "irt_item_results"."discrimination_a" is null and "irt_item_results"."guessing_c" is null)

irt_item_results_model_ck.name: irt_item_results_model_ck
irt_item_results_model_ck.value: "irt_item_results"."model_family" in ('LEGACY','2PL','GPCM') and ("irt_item_results"."model_family" = 'LEGACY' or ("irt_item_results"."guessing_c" is null and "irt_item_results"."rubric_version_id" is not null and "irt_item_results"."eligible_respondent_count" is not null and "irt_item_results"."eligible_respondent_count" between 0 and "irt_item_results"."sample_size"))

scoring_rubric_versions_approval_ck.name: scoring_rubric_versions_approval_ck
scoring_rubric_versions_approval_ck.value: "scoring_rubric_versions"."status" <> 'SEALED' or ("scoring_rubric_versions"."approved_by_user_id" is not null and "scoring_rubric_versions"."approved_at" is not null)

analysis_requests_input_ck.name: analysis_requests_input_ck
analysis_requests_input_ck.value: ("analysis_requests"."request_type" = 'GENERATE_VARIANTS' and "analysis_requests"."wave_item_id" is not null) or ("analysis_requests"."request_type" = 'EVALUATE_PACKAGE' and "analysis_requests"."package_id" is not null) or ("analysis_requests"."request_type" in ('CALIBRATE_ORIGINAL','COMPARE_VARIANTS','MONITOR_PRODUCTION','CALIBRATE_TRYOUT') and "analysis_requests"."snapshot_id" is not null)

measurement_contexts_scope_ck.name: measurement_contexts_scope_ck
measurement_contexts_scope_ck.value: ("measurement_contexts"."ecosystem" = 'DRILL' and "measurement_contexts"."level_id" is not null and "measurement_contexts"."tryout_batch_id" is null) or ("measurement_contexts"."ecosystem" = 'TRYOUT' and "measurement_contexts"."tryout_batch_id" is not null and "measurement_contexts"."level_id" is null)

response_snapshot_items_category_ck.name: response_snapshot_items_category_ck
response_snapshot_items_category_ck.value: "response_snapshot_items"."maximum_score_category" > 0 and ("response_snapshot_items"."score_category" is null or "response_snapshot_items"."score_category" between 0 and "response_snapshot_items"."maximum_score_category")

response_snapshot_items_points_ck.name: response_snapshot_items_points_ck
response_snapshot_items_points_ck.value: "response_snapshot_items"."max_points" > 0 and ("response_snapshot_items"."awarded_points" is null or "response_snapshot_items"."awarded_points" between 0 and "response_snapshot_items"."max_points")

response_snapshots_freeze_ck.name: response_snapshots_freeze_ck
response_snapshots_freeze_ck.value: "response_snapshots"."status" <> 'FROZEN' or ("response_snapshots"."digest" is not null and "response_snapshots"."row_count" >= 0 and "response_snapshots"."frozen_at" is not null)

trial_family_reservations_invalid_ck.name: trial_family_reservations_invalid_ck
trial_family_reservations_invalid_ck.value: ("trial_family_reservations"."invalidated_at" is null and "trial_family_reservations"."invalidating_exposure_id" is null and "trial_family_reservations"."reason" is null) or ("trial_family_reservations"."invalidated_at" is not null and "trial_family_reservations"."invalidating_exposure_id" is not null and "trial_family_reservations"."reason" is not null)

trial_phases_ab_pins_ck.name: trial_phases_ab_pins_ck
trial_phases_ab_pins_ck.value: "trial_phases"."purpose" <> 'VARIANT_AB' or "trial_phases"."status" = 'PLANNED' or ("trial_phases"."candidate_question_version_id" is not null and "trial_phases"."baseline_id" is not null and "trial_phases"."reference_set_id" is not null and "trial_phases"."comparison_policy_id" is not null)

trial_phases_window_ck.name: trial_phases_window_ck
trial_phases_window_ck.value: "trial_phases"."cutoff_at" is null or ("trial_phases"."opens_at" is not null and "trial_phases"."cutoff_at" > "trial_phases"."opens_at")

tryout_attempt_results_bounds_ck.name: tryout_attempt_results_bounds_ck
tryout_attempt_results_bounds_ck.value: ("tryout_attempt_results"."rank" is null or "tryout_attempt_results"."rank" > 0) and ("tryout_attempt_results"."percentile" is null or "tryout_attempt_results"."percentile" between 0 and 100) and ("tryout_attempt_results"."standard_error" is null or "tryout_attempt_results"."standard_error" >= 0)

tryout_result_finalizations_irt_ck.name: tryout_result_finalizations_irt_ck
tryout_result_finalizations_irt_ck.value: "tryout_result_finalizations"."mode" <> 'IRT' or ("tryout_result_finalizations"."source_output_id" is not null and "tryout_result_finalizations"."mapping_approval_id" is not null)

analysis_datasets_sealed_ck.name: analysis_datasets_sealed_ck
analysis_datasets_sealed_ck.value: "irt_compute"."analysis_datasets"."status" <> 'SEALED' or ("irt_compute"."analysis_datasets"."digest" is not null and "irt_compute"."analysis_datasets"."selected_count" >= 0 and "irt_compute"."analysis_datasets"."sealed_at" is not null)
